Building shown is an example; offices are spread across Cannon, Longworth and Rayburn.

notes: The LoC careers page I opened (Nov 2026) listed only a Work Study program and non-CRS jobs; its CRS postings were experienced roles. The CRS RA postings I read are from Sept 2023 (FDT Division, temporary, GS-5/7/9) and Dec 2024 (Gov and Finance, GS-9, no education requirement). Junior Fellows eligibility comes from a UChicago page; the official loc.gov program page did not load, so the program url points to the careers page. CRS offices are in the Madison Building (101 Independence Ave SE), which I did not confirm. Appointment is subject to a suitability investigation, not a clearance.

No clearance is mentioned on the pages opened, but GAO teams that cover defense or national security may require one (general knowledge).

Recent Graduates must graduate within two years (May 2026 qualifies). Program Analyst titles are common at USGS but I did not open a current one.

name: Congressional Budget Office (CBO)

The page says work usually involves research, data and statistical analysis, so strong quantitative skills help; his 3.3 GPA and poli-sci background may be a stretch. The address has no street number on CBO's page (building and intersection only). The job board showed only a Visiting Scholar opening; the page notes a background investigation, not a clearance. The Graduate Summer Intern program is for graduate students only.
